note: L10 (Intent) belongs to vect-or-edit / vect-or-engine and does not exist in this repository's SEMANTIC_LAYERS (0-9 only). It will be defined as a facet separately once that repository is available.

F.concept.description: Concept definition & relations (SKOS Concept equivalent). Includes senses[] (L4 Semantic/Definition)

F.form.description: Lexical form / lemma (LMF LexicalEntry equivalent). One form can reference multiple F.concept via senses[]

F.embedding.cloud-3072.description: Cloud text embedding provider, 3072-dim class (e.g. text-embedding-3-large). Placeholder id, actual provider set by user config
F.embedding.cloud-3072.note: Exception to the local-first principle. Enabled only with the user's explicit consent.

F.embedding.imagenet.description: ImageNet visual class hierarchy (WordNet-synset-keyed), cross-modal alignment

P.scan.description: Aho-Corasick text scanning (Module 0 baseline, zero-overhead fallback target)

P.wordnet.oewn.description: Open English WordNet backbone (~400k entries): synset relations, human-authored glosses
P.wordnet.oewn.role: Module 0 fallback source for relation-based disambiguation

P.conceptnet.description: ConceptNet commonsense graph: weighted, multilingual, crowd+dictionary sourced
P.conceptnet.role: Module 0 fallback source for commonsense relation edges (usedFor/capableOf/atLocation etc.)
P.conceptnet.note: confidence varies by edge; lower default trust than P.wordnet.oewn

G.policy.description: Policy rules referencing concept identifiers (abstract guideline). Guideline rules[] with severity: warning/info/hint map here.

G.rule.description: Strict enforcement rules (required fields, thresholds, hard constraints). Guideline rules[] with severity: error map here.

G.template.description: Document skeleton / slot templates (e.g. preset_clinical_templates.json). Scope: vect-or-generate output + vect-or-edit slot application (unverified, repo not yet obtained)

vocabularies._note: Open vocabularies validated against the registry (not hardcoded schema enums). Append new values here; no schema change required.
